meta.name: security-updates
meta.description: Secure boot and firmware update workflows for Zephyr RTOS. Covers MCUboot integration, production image signing, DFU protocols (MCUmgr), fail-safe rollback mechanisms, and mbedTLS crypto basics. Trigger when implementing over-the-air (OTA) updates, securing the boot process, or managing cryptographic keys.

copy.tagline: 安全升级嵌入式设备固件并保护启动流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在开发基于Zephyr的嵌入式设备固件更新方案
copy.tagline_en: Securely update firmware and protect boot process for embedded devices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are developing firmware update solutions for Zephyr-based embedded devices

howto.what: Claude 能帮你配置 Zephyr 系统的安全启动和固件更新，包括集成 MCUboot 引导加载程序、对固件镜像签名、通过 MCUmgr 远程更新、实现回滚保护以及使用 mbedTLS 加密。
howto.when: 当你需要实现 OTA 更新、保护启动过程或管理加密密钥时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 MCUboot 安全启动。
say.note: Claude 会指导你设置引导加载程序和分区。

say.text: 如何用 imgtool 签名固件镜像？
say.note: Claude 会说明签名工具和密钥管理。

say.text: 设置回滚保护防止变砖。
say.note: Claude 会介绍镜像确认和原子交换机制。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you configure secure boot and firmware updates for Zephyr systems, including integrating MCUboot bootloader, signing firmware images, remote updates via MCUmgr, fail-safe rollback, and mbedTLS crypto.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementing OTA updates, securing the boot process, or managing cryptographic keys.

say_en.text: Help me set up MCUboot secure boot.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through bootloader and partition setup.

say_en.text: How do I sign firmware images with imgtool?
say_en.note: Claude explains signing tools and key management.

say_en.text: Set up rollback protection to prevent bricking.
say_en.note: Claude covers image confirmation and atomic swap mechanisms.
